The '''Vagaari Corridor''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It connected the [[Celwis system/Legends|Celwis]] and [[Cormit system/Legends|Cormit systems]], which were located within [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. The Vagaari Corridor partially shared its name with the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]],<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of nomadic conquerors and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari Corridor was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
